properties.name: decimal friedman number
properties.definition: an integer expressible nontrivially from all of its decimal digits exactly once using permitted arithmetic operations.

properties.name: decimal narcissistic number
properties.definition: a nonnegative integer equal to the sum of its decimal digits, each raised to the number of digits.

properties.name: decimal palindrome
properties.definition: a nonnegative integer whose base-ten digits read identically in reverse.

properties.name: fibonacci number
properties.definition: a positive integer appearing in the fibonacci sequence beginning 1, 1, 2, 3, 5.

properties.name: perfect cube
properties.definition: a positive integer equal to the third power of a positive integer.

properties.name: perfect square
properties.definition: a positive integer equal to the second power of a positive integer.

properties.name: power of two
properties.definition: a positive integer equal to 2 raised to a nonnegative integer power.

properties.name: prime
properties.definition: a positive integer greater than one with exactly two positive divisors.

properties.name: triangular number
properties.definition: an integer of the form n(n + 1) / 2 for a positive integer n.

properties.name: twin-prime member
properties.definition: a prime differing by two from at least one other prime.

profileEntries.title: thirty-six at the threshold
profileEntries.body: sanhedrin 97b says that each generation has no fewer than thirty-six righteous people who greet the divine presence. the passage derives the count from the hebrew word lo in isaiah 30:18, whose letters lamed and vav have the numerical value 36.

profileEntries.title: the unavailable order
profileEntries.body: “eighty-six” appears in twentieth-century american lunch-counter slang for something unavailable, later broadening into a verb for eliminating or rejecting. proposed derivations remain uncertain.

profileEntries.title: the sky, standardized
profileEntries.body: in 1922 the international astronomical union agreed on a list of 88 constellations covering the entire sky. boundaries approved in 1928 and published in 1930 turned the modern constellations into defined celestial regions rather than merely recognized star pictures.

profileEntries.title: the thelemic greeting
profileEntries.body: thelemites customarily greet one another with “do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the law” and answer with “love is the law, love under will.” these phrases are often abbreviated as 93, a number signifying both will and love in thelemic numerology.

profileEntries.title: three days before the end
profileEntries.body: the national palace museum catalogs a tibetan kapala strand of 108 darkened human-bone beads, each set between thin turquoise plates. an inscription records its presentation by the sixth panchen lama at the qing court on 27 october 1780; he died in beijing three days later.

citations.label: National Palace Museum, Taipei — Kapala bone prayer beads

profileEntries.title: the almost-integer
profileEntries.body: the inverse fine-structure constant is close to 137 rather than exactly 137; its measured value continues beyond the integer.

profileEntries.title: the last room
profileEntries.body: wolfgang pauli was famously preoccupied with the inverse fine-structure constant, whose value lies near 137. when pauli's last assistant, charles enz, visited him in zürich's red cross hospital, pauli asked whether he had noticed the room number: 137. pauli died there on 15 december 1958.

citations.label: Charles P. Enz — No Time to Be Brief

profileEntries.title: lucina, numbered
profileEntries.body: minor planet 146 lucina is a main-belt asteroid discovered by alphonse borrelly at marseilles on 8 june 1875. it was named for lucina, the roman divinity of labor and childbirth.

citations.label: Dictionary of Minor Planet Names — (146) Lucina

profileEntries.title: cupid's stolen fire
profileEntries.body: shakespeare's sonnet 153 begins with cupid asleep beside his torch. a follower of diana steals the brand and quenches it in a cold spring, which becomes a heated medicinal bath; the speaker finds that the bath cannot cure his lovesickness.

profileEntries.title: yet was not the net broken
profileEntries.body: a vesica piscis has height √3 times its width; the classical lower approximation 265/153 gives 153 a precise geometric appearance. separately, john 21:11 numbers the post-resurrection catch at 153 fish and closes, “yet was not the net broken.” the records are presented together without claiming that one encodes the other.

profileEntries.title: babalon, enumerated
profileEntries.body: aleister crowley's liber lviii lists 156 as babalon and calls it 12 × 13, joining what the text describes as the most spiritual form of 13 with the most perfect number, 12. within crowley's system, 156 is declared symbolic apparatus rather than accidental resemblance.

profileEntries.title: the integer that wasn't
profileEntries.body: e^(π√163) is approximately 262537412640768743.99999999999925, an astonishing near-integer. in an april 1975 scientific american column, martin gardner jokingly claimed that it was exactly an integer and attributed the result to ramanujan; the prank helped attach ramanujan's name to the constant.

profileEntries.title: the gates of creation
profileEntries.body: sefer yetzirah sets the twenty-two hebrew letters in a wheel of 231 gates. the count matches every unordered pairing of two distinct letters, 22 × 21 ÷ 2, while the text imagines formed things and speech emerging through this combinatorial alphabet.

profileEntries.title: abraham's army, reread
profileEntries.body: genesis 14:14 numbers abraham's trained retainers at 318. clement of alexandria later reads the greek numeral notation τιη christologically: the character for 300 as the lord's sign, and iota-eta, 18, as an indication of the savior's name.

profileEntries.title: the murderous little oracle
profileEntries.epistemicRegister: official franchise history and contemporary report
profileEntries.body: in halo: combat evolved, 343 guilty spark is the installation's artificial-intelligence monitor, revered by the covenant as an oracle and intent on activating halo despite the catastrophic cost. microsoft later used 343 industries for its halo division; in 2024 the studio opened its next chapter as halo studios.

citations.label: GameSpot — Microsoft names internal Halo label?

profileEntries.title: the missing address
profileEntries.body: in http, status code 404 means that the origin server did not find a current representation for the requested resource, or is unwilling to disclose that one exists.

profileEntries.title: the word of the great work
profileEntries.body: aleister crowley wrote that he restored abracadabra as abrahadabra, analyzed it as a formula of the great work, and adopted the word and its numerical value 418 as an expression for the conduct of major magical operations.

profileEntries.title: the beast's alternate number
profileEntries.epistemicRegister: manuscript witness and scholarly textual criticism
profileEntries.body: papyrus 115, p. oxy. 4499, is a third- or fourth-century manuscript of revelation that preserves 616 at revelation 13:18 rather than the familiar 666. textual critic p. j. williams notes that both readings permit more than one gematric explanation: the variant is evidence, not a license to collapse a contested textual history into one solution.

citations.label: P. J. Williams — P115 and the Number of the Beast
University of Oxford — P. Oxy. LXVI 4499

profileEntries.title: the machine that failed forward
profileEntries.body: roland introduced the tr-808 rhythm composer in 1980. its analog drum sounds were initially dismissed as unrealistic; after the machine was discontinued, those sounds became embedded across hip-hop and electronic dance music.

profileEntries.title: the taxi defends itself
profileEntries.body: in g. h. hardy's retelling, he arrived to visit the ill srinivasa ramanujan in taxicab 1729 and called the number dull. ramanujan answered that it is the smallest positive integer expressible as a sum of two positive cubes in two ways: 1^3 + 12^3 = 9^3 + 10^3 = 1729.
